messages:
Sam: quick follow-up from the pm: we need a small set of tests to prevent the eviction/regression from slipping into release.
Lina: ok list them out and i'll take ownership of the prompt/regression set.
Sam: items: 1) 25-case prompt set for eviction/fallback failures; 2) nightly eviction regression job; 3) burst load scenario template; 4) 20-min chaos drill runbook; 5) rollout gating rule: block if critical-prompt eval drop >6%.
Lina: i'll own (1) and help with (2). est 5d for prompts + 2d to wire into nightly. target 2024-09-10.
Ethan: i'll do the burst load template (3). will include tail-latency and queue-length logging. target 2024-09-04.
Kat: i'll coordinate the chaos drill with SRE and runbook edits (4). prefer a low-risk window on staging. target 2024-09-15.
sre-bot: maintenance window available staging 2024-09-12 03:00-04:00 UTC; react :thumbsup: to accept.
Sam: about gating (5) - propose wiring eval alerts into the rollout pipeline. if any critical prompt drops >6%, pipeline fails and creates a remediation ticket automatically.
Lina: agreed. recorded traces + synthetic variants for prompts. annotate examples with detector labels.
Ethan: i'll open the perf PR and add template configs for perf-ci.
Kat: will draft the runbook and flag blast-radius controls.
Sam: Action recap: A1 prompt set (Lina) due 2024-09-10; A2 nightly job (Lina + ops) due 2024-09-12; A3 burst template (Ethan) due 2024-09-04; A4 chaos runbook + run (Kat) due 2024-09-15; A5 gating RFC (Sam) due 2024-09-03.
Lina: adding tickets to the postmortem board now and tagging "evals" and "recurrence".
Ethan: PR links forthcoming.
Sam: thanks everyone. small and focused, please keep CI runtime low and full-regression to nightly. ping me if blocked.
